description: I2L-OBS (WR-T-5): T3's trace loss, lag and retention alarms (infrx.traces.retention.policy.RULES, copied exactly; test_i2l_obs holds them equal) plus the Lab-only TraceGaugesDown (the exporter's own up gauge) over the Lab trace gauges textfile (trace_gauges.py). Same rule shape as infra/alerts/*.json. Lab-only: evaluated by the observe cycle only once WR-OBS-2 merges it and the traces role is enabled.

rules.name: TraceDeletionBacklogOld
rules.summary: A trace deletion or content expiry that nothing holds has waited more than 24 h for its physical cleanup (logical access is already gone).
rules.threshold_status: derived: O3, a deletion completes within 24 h (research/traces/01-requirements.md)

rules.name: FeedbackProjectionLagging
rules.summary: Accepted feedback has waited more than 15 min to reach the projection (acceptance is PostgreSQL's and is unaffected).
rules.threshold_status: est.: 30 redelivery windows of 30 s; ⚠️ TO BE VERIFIED against the measured pump interval

rules.name: TraceLossHigh
rules.summary: More than 1% of eligible traces were captured with a loss reason.
rules.threshold_status: est.: product default; ⚠️ TO BE VERIFIED against measured loss

rules.name: TraceSpoolFilling
rules.summary: The trace spool holds more than 80% of its byte cap: capture will pause.

rules.name: TraceGaugesDown
rules.summary: The Lab trace gauges exporter could not read its stores: every trace alarm above is blind until it recovers.
rules.threshold_status: exact: the gauge is 1 or 0 (Lab-only, beside T3's RULES; E5L fix round 0-F3)
